name: Sparse Voxel Grid Raycasting with Occupancy Grid
definition: A rendering method that uses a sparse occupancy grid (OccGrid) to accelerate volume rendering by traversing only occupied voxels, using a custom CUDA kernel `traverse_grids` to generate sample intervals.
summary: Sparse Voxel Grid Raycasting with Occupancy Grid accelerates volume rendering by using a hierarchical sparse grid to skip empty space, reducing texture reads compared to dense voxel methods and avoiding dynamic trees used in octree traversal.
